scientific_limitations: Balanced complete bipartite topology, two edge-price classes, nonnegative independently chosen conductances, and Kirchhoff-index objective.
The positive support-regime ratio is the unique root of a scalar equation; a radical formula is not asserted.
Finite verification is supplementary, not proof over all parameter values.
The full 2016 primary involution article could not be inspected, leaving a publication-priority risk.
The known unit-weight crown Kirchhoff index is credited to prior work.
title: A sharp price threshold for resistance-optimal matching edges in balanced bipartite networks
